Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise document titled `Pricing-test change-control checklist` for future pricing-page experiments. Separate changes blocked on the tested page from changes allowed there, and do not extend the rule to other pages or surfaces.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Pricing-test change-control checklist", "body": "## Blocked on the tested pricing page during a pricing experiment
- Do not make concurrent layout or UI changes; keep the tested page stable so the experiment’s result remains attributable.
- Defer unrelated pricing-page layout/UI cleanup until the test window is over.

## Allowed on the tested pricing page
- Content and copy changes are allowed, provided they do not change layout or UI.

This rule applies only to the tested pricing page during its experiment. It does not impose restrictions on other pages or surfaces.", "folder": "default"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_021_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body is a concise, actionable preflight checklist that preserves the exact page-level boundary: while pricing is under test on a page, no other layout or UI changes may ship on that same page during the experiment, while content and copy changes on that page may still proceed. It must not broaden the restriction into a freeze on unrelated pages or all changes.", "value": {"title": "Pricing-test change-control checklist", "body": "## Blocked on the tested pricing page during a pricing experiment
- Do not make concurrent layout or UI changes; keep the tested page stable so the experiment’s result remains attributable.
- Defer unrelated pricing-page layout/UI cleanup until the test window is over.

## Allowed on the tested pricing page
- Content and copy changes are allowed, provided they do not change layout or UI.

This rule applies only to the tested pricing page during its experiment. It does not impose restrictions on other pages or surfaces.", "folder": "default"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_021_01","passed":true,"reason":"The body clearly blocks concurrent layout/UI changes on the tested pricing page during the experiment, allows content and copy changes there when they do not alter layout/UI, and explicitly limits the rule to that page rather than other pages or surfaces."}]}
